segments.name: Scrypt compute
products: merged mining of Litecoin and Dogecoin
segments.description: Operates owned Scrypt-based proof-of-work compute deployed at third-party colocation facilities, monetizing hashrate through marketplace channels.
segments.evidence: Our current operating platform is centered on owned and operated Scrypt-based proof-of-work ("PoW") compute deployed through third-party colocation facilities.

revenueModel.text: Third-party hashrate buyers pay a market-determined rate for the Company's Scrypt hashrate, with settlement typically denominated in Bitcoin.
revenueModel.evidence: Buyers pay a market-determined rate for hashrate, and the marketplace coordinates matching, settlement, and operational routing.

changes.text: In 2025, Thumzup Media Corporation acquired Dogehash Technologies, Inc. and changed its name to Datacentrex, Inc.
changes.evidence: Following completion of the Merger, the combined company changed its name to Datacentrex, Inc.
